```python
t0 = df.loc[df['Class'] == 0]
t1 = df.loc[df['Class'] == 1]
```

To:
```python
t0 = data_df.loc[data_df['Class'] == 0]
t1 = data_df.loc[data_df['Class'] == 1]
```

This ensures the subsets include all columns from `data_df`, including the 'Hour' column that was created in cell 2. All cells now execute successfully without errors.
